source_policy: Exact source file and normalized text hashes are preserved.
Collection V publication binding is verified by entry number, case number and date; it is not remote/original-decision binding.
Only the user-supplied non-contiguous entries are recorded; unprovided entry numbers are not inferred, synthesized or marked processed.
Every item is historical and requires current-law verification before present-law reliance.
No party identities are expanded or deanonymized beyond the supplied source.
No ECLI, URL, later treatment, current-law status or binding force is invented.
